DiagnosticLoggingTests.Startup_fault_is_.reason: Both original normal-sink states execute through the real frontend fallback file writer with no logger/host dependency. A real missing-file IO error supplies the actual native ENOENT code and numeric errno; its new frontend Error carries the exact unstructured-private-secret message and a named startupIoFault callsite. The log retains type, named callsite, native numeric code, build/commit/run/OS/runtime and excludes that arbitrary message, selected data root and failing file path. The open-sink row retains a real logs/diagnostic.log file handle while the separate electron-startup-failure.log is written. JavaScript has no .NET IOException.HResult: actual Node code/errno is the explicit platform adaptation, never a fabricated HRESULT. Human alert still carries useful scrubbed original fault text separately from the persistent record. Rotation remains bounded at the existing 512 KiB threshold; giant-message and multiline fake-frame tests preserve privacy and finite event size.

Existing independent logger and surface failure tests retain the original exit status rather than replacing it with reporting failures.
